title: The Power of Perspective: How Your Mindset Affects Your Perception

html:
Change can be a powerful tool to bring brightness or darkness into our lives. Whether it’s a positive or negative change, it can have a huge impact on how we view our life and how we live it. A positive change can bring a newfound sense of hope, purpose, and optimism, while a negative change can bring fear, uncertainty, and even despair.

This is especially true when it comes to artificial intelligence (AI).

Recently, I asked AI to create two different images , one that represents the brightness AI can bring to the world, and another that represents the darkness. The result for the brightness image was a bright human face with hope on the face and colors coming out. This represents the potential of AI to bring positive change and brighten our world.

On the other hand, the result for the darkness image was a face that showed a sci-fi villain that would end the world. This illustrates the potential negative consequences of rejecting change and seeing AI as a threat.

The difference is visible when we accept the change and open our minds to the possibilities of AI, versus rejecting change and seeing it as a danger. If we can shift our perspective and embrace the potential of AI, we can bring brightness into our lives and create a better future for ourselves and those around us.
